body.text: **Professional Experience** Kim joined Reliance Consulting in June 2008 as an Accountant. She is dedicated to working hard, constantly seeking to learn new things, and maintaining a strong work ethic. Prior to joining Reliance Consulting, she supervised the accounts receivable department for a division of a large nationwide distributing company for over 6 years, while also attending school part-time.

**Education** Kim graduated from the University of South Florida with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Accounting in December 2007. She is currently enrolled at the University of South Florida to complete the 5th year CPA requirement.
**Personal** Kim grew up in Milwaukee, Wisconsin until she moved to Tampa in 2001, looking for new endeavors. She currently resides in Tampa with her husband and children.
